One of the best uses of Radiohead in film and television comes in Black Mirror‘s unforgettable episode, Shut Up and Dance. As the devastating final moments unfold, Radiohead’s “Exit Music (For a Film)” slowly builds in the background, transforming an already shocking ending into one of the series’ most haunting sequences. 

Interestingly, the song wasn’t always guaranteed to stay in the episode. It was initially used as a temporary track during editing, but the production team ultimately secured permission from Radiohead after the band expressed their admiration for Black Mirror. 

The result is a perfect marriage of music and storytelling. The song’s gradual crescendo mirrors the episode’s emotional collapse, creating an ending that lingers long after the credits roll. It’s a reminder that sometimes the right piece of music doesn’t just accompany a scene—it defines it.
